title: Core: AS2 Date class built-in methods
description: Test compilation of AS2 Date class: var d = new Date(), new Date(year, month, day), d.getTime(), d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate(), d.getDay(), d.getHours(), d.getMinutes(), d.getSeconds(), d.getMilliseconds(), d.setTime(n), Date.UTC(y,m,d), Date.now(). Each should compile without error and emit ActionNew (0x4a) or ActionCallMethod (0x52).
